final: WITH category_averages AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS category_average FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS price_average FROM Products), above_overall AS (SELECT c.production_type_code, c.category_average, c.category_average - o.price_average AS difference FROM category_averages AS c CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.price_average IS NOT NULL AND c.category_average > o.price_average), above_overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(category_average) AS price_average FROM above_overall), above_both AS (SELECT a.category_average, a.difference, a.category_average - b.price_average AS second_difference FROM above_overall AS a CROSS JOIN above_overall_average AS b WHERE b.price_average IS NOT NULL AND a.category_average > b.price_average) SELECT AVG(category_average), AVG(difference), AVG(second_difference) FROM above_both
